name: Turku Cathedral
observations: Both photographs show the west entrance and tower; the portrait photograph includes the complete spire and cross.
No measured height is supplied. All metre values are approximate visual estimates using entrance and masonry proportions; dimensional confidence is approximately 0.45.
The tower has an irregular rubble-stone lower face transitioning unevenly into weathered red brick. Adjacent west-front wings have lower rubble-stone plinths.
Two tall, pale, arched window recesses sit above the pointed entrance portal.

Above the stone zone, three narrow tower openings form the lowest brick-stage row, followed by one central arched opening. Higher openings are staggered among pale blind recesses and circular decorations.
Tower opening_rows approximate visible openings on the front face only; sill heights use the entrance terrace as the provisional datum and exclude the descending plaza steps.
Black clock faces with gold detailing occupy adjacent tower faces below a projecting pale corbelled cornice and a red-brick decorative parapet.
The dark, faceted belfry has large recessed Gothic louvred openings. The tapering copper spire has greener patina, visible seams, a small dormer, and a ball-and-cross finial.
Copper roof parameters primarily describe the visible spire. Main nave roof coverage and material cannot be established confidently from these views.
General window parameters approximate the visible west-front side-wing windows. Nave window dimensions, repetition, and mullion counts are obscured and should not be inferred from the tower.
Brick bond is provisionally monk; repairs and mixed masonry make a consistent bond uncertain.
Colours estimate neutral material albedo rather than shaded pixel values. Material-colour confidence is approximately 0.7; masonry unit sizes and seam spacing have lower confidence.
Tower minimum_height_m and maximum_width_m are approximate classification thresholds, not measurements of total tower height.

LOD2 Building_1156587 calibration: base 13.538m N2000, masonry tower top 64.51-64.56m, copper belfry top 78.26m, finial 102.528m. Heights in program are metres above base. Clock and bands scaled to masonry stage.
West entrance portal estimated 2.1m wide by4.3m tall above terrace; retain separate from nave windows.
